paragraphs: JDP sells employment screening and background check services to organizations making hiring decisions. Background screening is offered as a suite of FCRA-compliant checks returning researcher-verified information about candidates. Drug testing is ordered online, drawing on testing facilities across the country.

Other services on the homepage include social media screening, verifications of education, work history, licenses and credentials, and reference checks. Occupational health screening covers TB tests, titers, vaccinations and physicals. Form I-9 auditing produces documents that can be submitted to E-Verify in one click.

The about page says over 10,000 organizations use JDP for over 6 million screenings annually. JDP was founded in 2009 as a private, family-owned company. Named clients on these pages are Little League International and Groome Industrial Service Group.
